title: Where I've built.
sub: Across startups, enterprises, and everything in between.

roles.title: Software Development Engineer
roles.summary: Developed and shipped full-stack features for a multi-tenant fintech platform serving SMEs across the MENA region.
bullets: Owned end-to-end development across the backend, frontend, and database layers for Nym4Business, NymCard's Business platform.
Developed a configurable approval-rule engine supporting custom transaction conditions and multi-approver logic across roles and individuals.
Developed two-factor authentication and audit-logging mechanisms integrated with NymCard's core payment systems.
Built dashboards and GraphQL APIs facilitating management and data access across role and permission hierarchies.

roles.title: Software Development Engineer
roles.summary: Architected core microservices for Korn Ferry Talent Suite, serving enterprise clients in 150+ countries.
bullets: Developed core backend services with NestJS powering Korn Ferry Talent Suite, a global HR-tech platform serving organizations across 150+ countries.
Designed an internal routing system for inter-service communication, reducing inter-service latency by up to 70% and overall latency by up to 40%, with no handler changes required.
Built a streaming export system for multi-gigabyte audit logs, reconstructing data in real time to minimize server memory use and eliminate storage costs.
Designed an advanced request-tracing system capturing database and HTTP calls with zero added overhead in response pipelines.

roles.title: Founding Engineer & Technical Lead
roles.summary: Led technical design and engineering from pre-seed to production for a high-concurrency rental marketplace.
bullets: Founding engineer and technical lead, leading a team of three and owning most backend and desktop UI development from initial design through production.
Designed location-aware search combining maps, radius queries, and structured addresses, alongside a flexible CMS for category-specific listings and pricing.
Built real-time chat and notification system with per-listing conversation identity, live presence, and real-time listing updates.
Built a Stripe-integrated wallet and auto-renewal payment system around a hybrid ledger with hash-locked transactions.

roles.title: Full-Stack Developer
roles.summary: Built web applications for clients across 20+ countries while developing a broad foundation in software engineering.
bullets: Built full-stack applications across different products and industries, including gaming, video conferencing, and interactive coding education.
Mentored 100+ developers, from beginners learning the fundamentals to working professionals exploring system design and backend engineering.
